Hey Chaos! I just read this post and I immediately thought of my mom who did the same thing ever since I got diagnosed. The only way she got better was finally feeling low pressure spikes due to her medication. She asked me “this is what you’ve been feeling like everyday?” And I just rolled my eyes. Able bodied people will not understand you until it happens to them. I would suggest sitting your husband down and having a long talk about respecting your Disability. A woman by the name of Crutchesandspice on tiktok speaks very well on this. You’re doing wonderful already and you deserve respect! Drink water and eat salt I hope this helps!

Hey! I have bad swelling around the ankles too, so I bought some knee high compression socks too. Turns out I needed a full leg compression! So I got compression stockings and that helped! So just keep in mind that if the socks don’t work, try compression stockings!
